Subject: Exec roundtable — timebox and multi-zone slots (coordination)

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the quick sync at the end of last week. BlueWave’s exec team asked for a focused roundtable to align on product roadmap priorities and an on-site demo of the integration. We want to timebox the session (90 minutes total) with a 30-minute breakout for the BlueWave platform owners.

Quick questions so we can lock calendars and travel:
- Format preference: hybrid (some execs onsite, some joining remote) or fully onsite?
- Candidate weeks we have capacity for Redwood execs & AV rehearsal: Oct 21–22 or Oct 28–29. Any blocker for either week?
- Timezone constraints: we understand you have EMEA execs that prefer mornings CET — if hybrid, we can propose overlapping windows.
- Headcount: list of BlueWave attendees (names & travel needs) so we can estimate rooms/travel.

I attached a draft agenda and a simple travel/headcount sheet to complete. Can you confirm by COB Wed (Oct 6) so we can reserve a room and AV slot?

Attachments: BW_ExecRoundtable_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF), Travel_and_Holdings.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@bluewave.com>

Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bluewave.com>, BlueWave Logistics <logistics@bluewave.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exec roundtable — timebox and multi-zone slots (coordination)

Hi Monica —

Thanks — happy to coordinate. Quick answers:
- Preference: hybrid. Our CEO and two VPs will be onsite in SF; three EMEA execs will join remotely (CET morning).
- Preferred dates: Oct 21–22 are best; Oct 28–29 are backup.
- Suggested time windows (your local / our local): 10:30–12:00 PDT (18:30–20:00 CET) is late for EMEA — better to aim for 08:30–10:00 PDT (16:30–18:00 CET) or 11:00–12:30 PDT for West Coast execs.

I've attached our attendee list and an internal travel request form. AV requirements: live demo with two screens + local laptop capture. Can Redwood provide an AV runbook/point of contact for rehearsal?

Attachments: BW_Attendee_List.csv, BW_Travel_Request_Form.pdf

—Emma Zhao
Head of Partnerships, BlueWave Solutions
emma.zhao@bluewave.com | +44 20 7946 0812
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec roundtable — timebox and multi-zone slots (coordination)

Monica — forwarding Emma's availability. A couple operational notes from infra & events:

> On Mon, 05 Oct 2026 at 09:12 +0100 Emma Zhao wrote:
> > Preferred dates: Oct 21–22 are best; Oct 28–29 are backup.

1) Room & AV: Marissa, please flag the SF 2nd-floor boardroom and our reserve AV kit for Oct 21–22 (we need two inputs and an HDMI capture for demo). If that room is taken, fallback is 4th-floor lab.
2) Demo capacity: Aditya, can you confirm we can run the live inference demo in a rehearsal window (we need dedicated GPU access for a 45-minute demo + 15-minute Q&A)? If not, propose a recorded fallback.
3) Travel approvals: Finance has a soft cap for consolidated travel for execs on partner demos. Monica, if BlueWave wants Redwood to coordinate travel bookings, we need a written list and pre-approval from Procurement.

Proposed timeblocks to offer (local / CET):
- Option A: Oct 21, 08:30–10:00 PDT (17:30–19:00 CET) — good overlap for EMEA PMs remotely.
- Option B: Oct 21, 11:00–12:30 PDT (20:00–21:30 CET) — better for West Coast execs but late for EMEA.

Let's finalize by EOD Wed and I will kick off the AV booking and GPU reservation.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships Ops
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0103

- 08:30–09:00 PDT / 17:30–18:00 CET — Welcome & executive context (all)
- 09:00–09:45 PDT / 18:00–18:45 CET — Live integration demo (Redwood infra team + BlueWave tech)
- 09:45–10:15 PDT / 18:45–19:15 CET — Breakout (platform owners)
